payload.description:
# Slice 1: Prove a newsroom pod on one Anth.us story

## Intent

As an Anth.us editor, I want one real post to move through a Kanbus-configured newsroom workflow, so that we can determine whether file-native gates and coaching create useful editorial discipline before cloud infrastructure exists.

## Definition of Done

- The pod runs on a pinned released Kanbus version without Papyrus or Kanbus core changes.
- One story moves from idea through assignment, research, report, editor selection, copywriting, and publication using supported Kanbus transitions.
- Missing or invalid stage artifacts fail closed and explain how to recover.
- Coaching, blocks, recoveries, false positives, and human interventions are recorded separately.
- Publication idempotently generates a marked Anth.us MDX file and CI detects divergence from the pod source.
- A real Anth.us post is published through the workflow.
- A findings record makes an explicit proceed, revise, or stop decision and identifies only evidence-supported follow-up work.

## Non-goals

- Evidence for the external funnel hypothesis.
- Changes to Kanbus core or either runtime.
- Hosted Papyrus features, identity enforcement, corpora, editions, or layout.
- A reusable public template before the real story exposes what should be generalized.
payload.title: Slice 1: Prove a newsroom pod on one Anth.us story
